# submission name:

`semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1`

> **Submission frozen and ready for official evaluation.** PR head
> `9a77b6ad660d6310ab54436757ab07a9bbc9f3e1`; canonical archive SHA-256
> `0491d5df84fc70b62b3f7ccf8894f5e1b81c616de46a052e4423fc1e18fdc7cd`.

# upload zipped `archive.zip`

[Download `archive.zip`](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma_video_compression_challenge/releases/download/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1/archive.zip)

- Size: `191,052` bytes
- SHA-256: `0491d5df84fc70b62b3f7ccf8894f5e1b81c616de46a052e4423fc1e18fdc7cd`
- ZIP contents: one stored member named `p`

# report.txt

```text
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.00001967
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.00028609
  Submission file size: 191,052 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,489 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.00508855
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + √(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 0.17
```

The official evaluator prints the score to two decimals. Using its displayed
metrics and exact byte counts gives approximately `0.1698476624`.

# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?

Yes — please use `linux-nvidia-t4` / CUDA.

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?

Yes. `compress.sh`, `repack_carrier.py`, the lossless carrier codec, integrity
checks, and golden tests are included and are okay to merge. This is the exact
hash-locked final CPR1 compression stage: it reproduces the canonical archive. 

- [Full reproducibility repository](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma-ai-semantic-pose-hpac-cpr1) the original multi-day model-training pipeline uploaded to standalone repo to avoid bloating the challenge repo.

# is this submission competitive or innovative? explain why

Both. The completed 600-sample RTX 2000 Ada evaluation scored `0.17`; official
T4 evaluation is still required. The submission combines the inherited
semantic-token/HPAC architecture with an integer-lattice entropy path, a
standalone learned neutral-gray pose carrier, and an exact canonical
Huffman/Rice lossless repack.

The lineage is documented explicitly:

- [Lineage and citations](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma_video_compression_challenge/blob/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1/submissions/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1/LINEAGE_AND_CITATIONS.md)
- [Submission README and verification evidence](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma_video_compression_challenge/tree/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1/submissions/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1)

# additional comments

The report above is from a complete 600-sample CUDA evaluation of this
byte-identical archive and inflation code on an independent RTX 2000 Ada. The
subsequent PR cleanup only renamed the submission directory, added
documentation, and squashed the branch; it did not change the charged archive
or runtime decoder. Please run the final official evaluation on
`linux-nvidia-t4`.

## reproducibility and frozen state

The complete reproduction package is public at
[fesalfayed/comma-ai-semantic-pose-hpac-cpr1](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma-ai-semantic-pose-hpac-cpr1).
It includes the retained checkpoints and evidence, a byte-exact frozen rebuild,
and a separate strict 49-stage raw-video-to-official-score pipeline that
rejects circular use of the frozen artifacts.

- Frozen repository commit:
  [`2f94596bb0136d342254022a5c9584756eae0468`](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma-ai-semantic-pose-hpac-cpr1/commit/2f94596bb0136d342254022a5c9584756eae0468)
- Frozen tag and release:
  [`semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1`](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma-ai-semantic-pose-hpac-cpr1/releases/tag/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1)
- Reproduction lineage:
  [`LINEAGE_AND_CITATIONS.md`](https://github.com/fesalfayed/comma-ai-semantic-pose-hpac-cpr1/blob/semantic-pose-HPAC_CPR1/LINEAGE_AND_CITATIONS.md)
- Clean anonymous-clone verification: byte-identical `191,052`-byte archive
  reconstruction and `23 passed`.

This PR is frozen at the head and archive hashes shown above. No further
submission-code or archive changes are planned; it is ready for official T4
evaluation and maintainer review.

Technical write-up:
https://fesalfayed.com/blog/semantic-pose-compression/

I am also interested in internship opportunities at comma.ai, if any are
available.

Thanks for the submission @fesalfayed! 🤏

A maintainer will review your PR shortly.

To run the evaluation, a maintainer will trigger the `eval` workflow with your PR number.

Independent reproduction completed on the canonical CPR1 artifact (`sha256:0491d5df84fc70b62b3f7ccf8894f5e1b81c616de46a052e4423fc1e18fdc7cd`) at source head `4ea9513451a0bc375faa84c97b8820410fefe918`.

On an RTX 5070, the unmodified official wrapper scored all 600 samples in 142.098 s. An isolated precision-only diagnostic (official evaluator bytes preserved) produced: pose `1.94819294847548e-05`, seg `0.0002959781268145889`, rate `0.005088547388475883`, exact score `0.17076926565506415`. Output was 1,200 frames / 3,662,409,600 bytes, SHA-256 `bc3c6b6092ae26f76ef375ce9314d1270ad57380341608f6dc5b43467cf9c650`. Current resolution used `constriction 0.5.0` successfully.

Reproduction evidence and verifier are durable at VeigaPunk commit `102de866016eaf6e9a9acd7ebe8221ee6038bca0`: https://github.com/VeigaPunk/comma_video_compression_challenge/commit/102de866016eaf6e9a9acd7ebe8221ee6038bca0

This independently clears the local `<0.187` and 30-minute gates. A challenge-owned `linux-nvidia-t4` run remains necessary for official leaderboard verification.

Submission is now frozen and ready for maintainer review and the official
`linux-nvidia-t4` evaluation.
